player_prompt.intro: Udlala i-Slitherlink ku- {R}x{C} grid! Dweba iluphu eyodwa eqhubekayo ukuze iseli ngalinye elibhalwe inombolo libe nemiphetho eminingi. Shintsha imiphetho nge: [h r c] - shintsha umphetho ovundlile ngaphezu kwamaphoyinti emgqeni r, ikholomu c [v r c] - shintsha umphetho ovundlile ngakwesobunxele samaphoyinti emgqeni r, ikholomu c Izinombolo zibonisa inani lemphetho elidingekayo, '.' kusho ukuthi akukho mkhawulo. Unokuhamba okufika ku- {max_turns} ukuxazulula iphazili.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yesenzo esibi. Sebenzisa u- [h row col] noma u- [v row col].
